effTarget.title: Efficiency target
effTarget.subtitle: A completed-week goal workspace built from the observed history window
effTarget.chartHint: Green weeks beat the target; the dashed line is your goal
effTarget.methodNote: Weeks run Monday to Sunday in your local time. A week hits the target when its distance-weighted consumption lands at or below your goal.
effTarget.noData: No drives with at least 1 km of distance and measured energy are available in this observed window.

pulse.title: Goal pulse
pulse.noCompleted: No completed eligible week is available to grade yet.
pulse.noActive: No eligible drives have been observed in the active week.

weekly.title: Weekly consumption vs target
weekly.subtitle: Bars show observed weekly consumption; the line is a trailing four-calendar-week distance-weighted trend.
weekly.aria: Weekly consumption bars, target line, and rolling four-week trend with the active partial week distinguished
weekly.empty: No eligible weekly observations are available for this chart.

weekday.title: Weekday efficiency pattern
weekday.subtitle: Each day uses distance-weighted eligible drives from the observed history window.
weekday.aria: Distance-weighted consumption by weekday with target reference
weekday.empty: No eligible drives are available for a weekday pattern.

consistency.title: Target consistency
consistency.subtitle: Completed weeks: on target ≤ goal, near miss ≤ 10% over, off track > 10% over.
consistency.aria: Completed week counts across on-target, near-miss, and off-track bands
consistency.empty: No completed eligible weeks are available for consistency bands.

score.title: Recent completed-week scorecard
score.subtitle: Rank 1 is the lowest-consumption completed week in the observed history window.
score.empty: No completed eligible weeks are available for the scorecard.

method.title: Coverage & methodology
method.calendar: Weeks run Monday through Sunday in local browser time.
method.eligibility: A drive qualifies with measured positive energy and at least 1 km of distance.
method.weighting: Consumption is total energy divided by total distance, not an average of drive averages.
method.activeExclusion: The active week stays visible as a snapshot but is excluded from hit rate, streaks, bands, and ranking.
method.rolling: The rolling line weights eligible energy and distance observed in the current and previous three calendar weeks.
method.empty: Coverage will appear when drive history is returned for the selected vehicle.
method.coverage: {{eligible}} eligible and {{excluded}} excluded across {{observed}} returned rows.
method.capped: This request reached the {{limit}}-drive API cap. Results describe the returned history window; older drives may not be represented.
method.window: Results describe the {{count}} drives returned in this observed history window, up to the {{limit}}-drive API limit.

brief.completedScope: Latest completed eligible week; target grading and streaks exclude the active week.
